description: REAP - Prompts for you to use REA (Reverse Engineer Anything), get the most out of it, and clone or break down any program

detail.readme_excerpt: # REA Investigation Prompts (REAP) — Reverse Engineering with your Coding Agent A curated collection of prompts for [REA (Reverse Engineer Anything)](https://rea.tools/) — the toolset that lets your AI coding agent inspect how software works, from native binaries, firmware and kernels to games, Electron apps, APKs and websites. Prompts are ready to paste into your agent. Replace everything in `` and keep each request focused on **one feature** — narrow questions get evidence-backed answers. ## Star History ## Install as agent skills (recommended) `setup.sh` (macOS/Linux) or `setup.bat` (Windows) copies every prompt section into your coding agent's skills folder (`~/.hermes/skills`, `~/.claude/skills`, `~/.codex/skills`, or `~/.gemini/config/skills` for Antigravity): ```bash ./setup.sh # auto-detect installed agents ./setup.sh antigravity # or: hermes | claude-code | codex | antigravity | all ``` ```bat setup.bat :: Windows ``` What you get: - **`Skills/`** — 26 skill packs, one folder per section (`reap-00-install-and-verify` … `reap-22-go-and-rust-binary-source-recovery`, plus `reap-prompts` index, `reap-wildcard` and `reap-prompt-writing-tips`), each a `SKILL.md` with YAML frontmatter the agent auto-loads when relevant. - **`system_prompt.md`** — the whole library as a single document you can paste into any agent's system prompt / custom instructions instead of installing skills. - **`tools/build_skills.py`** and **`tools/build_system_prompt.py`** — regenerate `Skills/` and `system_prompt.md` from `readme.md` (the setup scripts run them automatically; `readme.md` stays the source of truth). ## Sources & credits - **REA tools & guides:** https://rea.tools/ - **Official prompt gallery:** https://madewithrea.com/prompts - **Intro thread ("REA is the most dangerous thing on the internet right now")** by codila — https://x.com/0xCodila/status/2109623431763292649 (quoting Matthew Berman — https://x.com/MatthewBerman/status/2108245653843509415) - **REAP Name** by https://x.com/zazencodes?s=11 ## Table of contents | # | Section | |---|---------| | 0 | [Install & verify](#0-install--verify) | | 1 | [Getting started](#1-getting-started) | | 2 | [Feature tracing (any program)](#2-feature-tracing-any-program) | | 3 | [Native binary exploration](#3-native-binary-exploration) | | 4 | [Software & feature cloning](#4-software--feature-cloning)
